cards.title: Play School is back – and with it the promise of TV I'm actually happy for my toddler to watch
cards.body: This beloved children's program offers a refreshing alternative to frantic shows designed to grab attention like smartphones do. Parents can feel good about their toddlers watching quality content that supports healthy viewing habits.

cards.title: Is your kid off to a sleepover? Don't forget the secret codeword
cards.body: Establishing a discreet signal allows children to communicate distress at sleepovers without embarrassment in front of peers. This simple safety strategy gives both parents and kids peace of mind during overnight visits.

cards.title: Being a working parent is a logistical nightmare. Imagine if school holidays were something we looked forward to
cards.body: Working parents face constant juggling between job demands and school schedules, making time with children difficult. The article explores how school holiday planning could be reimagined to benefit family time.

cards.title: EV drivers love their cars, but some passengers feel sick - this could be why
cards.body: Motion sickness in electric vehicles affects certain passengers differently, with children and women more susceptible due to sensory mismatches. Understanding this helps parents manage their children's comfort during EV travel.
